$description: IBM Carbon primitive tier: palette (@carbon/colors@11.58.0), IBM Plex families and weights (@carbon/type@11.67.0), spacing, sizes, icon sizes and border radius (@carbon/layout@11.59.0), durations and easings (@carbon/motion@11.52.0). rem converted to px at 16px/rem.

color.$description: Carbon colour palette from @carbon/colors@11.58.0 (colors + hoverColors). Hover steps are named <step>-hover, as in Carbon's Sass ($gray-10-hover).

border-radius.$description: Carbon border radius, $border-radius-00..max (@carbon/layout@11.59.0). Carbon components are square (00); max is for pills and avatars.
